newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch business confidence falls in February.
newsitem.headline: Dutch business confidence falls in February.

text.p: The index of Dutch business confidence fell in February from January, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Monday. The index has been calculated according to a new method.
DUTCH BUSINESS CONFIDENCE INDEX (No base date)

The business confidence index is derived from the monthly CBS survey among Dutch manufacturers and is intended to provide an indication of how Dutch manufacturing production will develop in the coming four to five months.

The index is calculated from manufacturers' answers to three questions about the expected level of business activity in the coming three months, the level of orders on their books and the level of their stocks of finished products.
Starting with the February data, the CBS has recalculated the index according to a new method, making it directly comparable to its consumer confidence indicator.
The data is adjusted for structurally recurring distortions and seasonal influences and the final figure is calculated as the mathematical average of the three component series.
The questions are the same as those used in compiling the European Commission's industrial confidence indicator, CBS said.
The index has no base date. The lowest point of the recalculated index has a value of -9.0, dating from 1983.
